mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL above 215) triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 215), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and payrolls (PAYEMS) signals robust consumer demand and labor market strength, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST exceeds 505 and PAYEMS exceeds 132000, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 8.5%), weak labor market conditions suppress consumer spending and corporate profit growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 8.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in economic slowdown.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 98, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Strong residential sales (RSAFS above 350,000 million dollars) indicate robust consumer spending and economic growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of triggered instances (RSAFS > 350000), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 215) and elevated interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) signals aggressive monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of periods where both CPIAUCSL exceeds 215 and FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In an industrial slowdown regime (INDPRO < 98), the market anticipates policy stimulus to support the economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 98, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
